title: Large Language Models
overview: Understand how transformer-based language models are trained to predict tokens and how they are adapted for use.
objectives: Explain self-attention at a high level

method.title: Next-token prediction
method.body: LLMs are pretrained on large text corpora to predict the next token, learning broad statistical patterns of language.

method.title: Transformers
method.body: Self-attention lets each token weigh other tokens in the context, enabling parallel training.

method.title: Adaptation
method.body: Models are adapted by instruction fine-tuning, preference-based training, and prompting with examples.

method.title: Limitations
method.body: LLMs can produce fluent but incorrect statements, called hallucinations, and are bounded by their context window.

pseudocode:
tokens = tokenize(prompt)
while not stop:
    logits = model(tokens)
    probs = softmax(logits[-1] / temperature)
    tokens.append(sample(probs))
